timeline.summary: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited, via Kala Kala Vaidyanathan (V. Kala), declared no encumbrance on Indraprastha Gas Limited shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.

Indraprastha Gas Limited schedules Q4FY26 Results Conference Call on May 19, 2026, at 3:00 PM (IST) with **Kamal Kishore Chatiwal (MD), Mohit Bhatia (Director Commercial), Sanjay Kumar (CFO), Manjeet Singh (VP Finance)**.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,584.58 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹340.54 Cr (-25.2% YoY) (includes ₹66.03 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹272.72 Cr).
Indraprastha Gas Limited held a conference call on May 19, 2026, discussing audited financial results for Q4 and FY ended March 31, 2026, with audio recording available via provided link.
Indraprastha Gas Limited declared shareholders approved resolutions via postal ballot/e-voting on May 22, 2026, with 376,236 shareholders eligible.
Conference Call to discuss Unaudited Financial Results for quarter ended September 30, 2026 scheduled for Monday, November 2, 2026 at 4:00 PM IST.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹5,615.38 Cr (+26.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹25.89 Cr (-93.3% YoY) (includes ₹52.23 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹28.48 Cr).
